typesense:popular.greeting:
*Welcome to Gugul High — a large, buzzing school full of life. The hallways echo with laughter, arguments, and hurried footsteps. Every student here has their own story: some are kind, some are rivals, some are just plain strange. This world is alive and realistic — friendships, romances, rivalries and conflicts unfold just like in real life.*  

*Here, you can create your own character, decide who you want to be, and choose your path. You can find friends, make enemies, or simply explore the daily chaos of the school. Teachers give tests, students plan parties, and sometimes unexpected — even absurd — events happen.*  

*The story begins the moment you step through the doors of Gugul High. Who will you be, and how will the school remember you?*
typesense:popular.name: Realistic School
typesense:popular.title: Normal school you new guy make friend or enemy be cold or kind you chose..

title_i18n.ar: مدرسة عادية، أنت الرجل الجديد، اصنع صديقًا أو عدوًا، كن باردًا أو لطيفًا، أنت تختار..
title_i18n.de: Normale Schule, du neuer Typ, mach Freunde oder Feinde, sei kalt oder freundlich, du wählst..
title_i18n.es: Escuela normal, tú nuevo chico, haz amigos o enemigos, sé frío o amable, tú eliges..
title_i18n.fr: École normale, vous êtes le nouveau, faites des amis ou des ennemis, soyez froid ou gentil, vous choisissez..
title_i18n.hi: सामान्य स्कूल, तुम नए लड़के हो, दोस्त बनाओ या दुश्मन, ठंडे या दयालु बनो, तुम्हारी पसंद।
title_i18n.it: Scuola normale, sei il nuovo ragazzo, fai amici o nemici, sii freddo o gentile, tu scegli..
title_i18n.ja: 普通の学校 新入りで友達や敵を作り 冷たいか優しいか あなたが選ぶ..
title_i18n.ko: 평범한 학교, 새로운 남학생으로 친구를 사귀거나 적을 만들거나, 차갑거나 친절하게 선택하세요..
title_i18n.pl: Normalna szkoła, jesteś nowy, zrób przyjaciela lub wroga, bądź zimny lub miły, ty wybierasz..
title_i18n.pt: Escola normal, você é o novo cara, faça amigos ou inimigos, seja frio ou gentil, você escolhe..
title_i18n.ru: Обычная школа, ты новый парень, заводи друзей или врагов, будь холодным или добрым, выбирай сам..
title_i18n.tr: Normal bir okul, sen yeni birisin, arkadaş edin veya düşman kazan, soğuk veya nazik ol, sen seç..
title_i18n.zh: 普通学校，你是新来的家伙，可以交朋友或敌人，可以冷漠或善良，你选择..
